seed.description: The encrypted seed data for the RSA SecurID token, typically base64 encoded.

pwdhash.description: The hash of the password used to encrypt the seed. Empty if the token is stored without a password.

pin.description: The Personal Identification Number (PIN) required for the token. Empty if no PIN is used or stored.

devid.description: The device ID (GUID) bound to the token. Used to decrypt class-bound tokens.

exp.description: The expiration date of the token as a Unix timestamp. 0 indicates the token does not expire.

type.description: The format type of the token, such as 'ctf' (compressed token format) or 'sdtid' (XML format).

user.description: The username associated with the token, often used in sdtid formats.

serial.description: The serial number of the token hardware or software instance.

mac.description: The Message Authentication Code (MAC) checksum used to verify the integrity of the token data.
